confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of George Town pricing, not checked against live menus, bar lists or booking pages. Restaurant and café anchors are the more reliable; cocktail and wine are weakly known, so they are set at about 2.3 times the beer anchor. Hotel and hostel anchors are the least certain and could vary widely by neighbourhood and season. FX: the 2026-10-15 RBA figure comes from a search summary attributed to the RBA exchange-rates page, which I could not open or verify directly. A third-party 2026-10-16 figure was not used.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on mid-sized Malaysian and Southeast Asian tourist cities with similar guesthouse, hostel and hawker-plus-café dining patterns, such as Melaka and Ipoh, adjusted to George Town's tourism level. No Penang listings were checked.
